correctness.rationale: In any connected triangle-free graph, a dismantlable dominated vertex is a leaf, so the nonempty induced cop-win subgraphs are exactly trees. The selected nonempty ladder columns form a contiguous interval in symbols top,bottom,double; connectivity and acyclicity are equivalent to excluding TB, BT and DD as adjacent pairs. Transfer recurrences U_{ell+1}=z(U_ell+2V_ell), V_{ell+1}=z^2 U_ell and placement factor n-ell+1 yield the claimed t z(2+z+3t z^2)/((1-t)^2(1-tz-2t²z³)). A second singleton-gap count verifies the coefficient binomial formula; reliability follows from p/(1-p) substitution and first moment by derivative. Independently enumerated all nonempty graph vertex subsets n=1..8, tested acyclicity/connectivity and transfer coefficients, including n=4 counts 8,10,16,18,16,10 and moment identity; unrestricted theorem rests on the complete forbidden-word bijection.

originality.rationale: The unweighted induced-tree counts C_n(1) and maximum-tree cardinalities/multiplicities occur in OEIS A360202/A360920/A360918; they are expressly prior art. Vince studies all connected induced vertex subsets and their mean density 3/4, not necessarily induced trees. Ahmed–Cameron defines node cop-win reliability and handles unicyclic/bicyclic host graphs; L_n has n-1 independent cycles. Its all-size, all-n cardinality distribution is not implied by those scalar results. Both relevant historical full texts were inaccessible (Oxford VPN disconnected), so equivalent specialized formulas remain risk.
